APP_HELP: Decrypts USM video files and muxes them into .mkv.
HELP_INPUT: USM files, or folders containing them.
HELP_NO_CLEANUP: Keeps the decrypted .ivf, .hca, and .ass files after muxing instead of deleting them.
HELP_VAPOURSYNTH: Filter the video with the VapourSynth preset in vs/default.py (re-encodes with x265).
HELP_HARD_SUB: Burns the default subtitle into the video (no soft subs will be muxed). Good for playing somewhere that doesn't support soft subs. Re-encodes with the x265 settings.
HELP_CRF: x265 CRF value when the video is re-encoded (--vapoursynth or --hard-sub).
HELP_PRESET: x265 preset when the video is re-encoded (--vapoursynth or --hard-sub).
HELP_X265_PARAMS: Custom x265 parameters (colon-separated). Replaces the built-in tuning.
HELP_JSON: Emit JSON events on stdout for the GUI.
HELP_PROBE: Check whether each USM file has a decryption key and local subtitles, without demuxing anything.
HELP_CRACK: Recover each file's decryption key from its video, without demuxing anything.
HELP_UPDATE: Check GitHub for a newer release and update.
HELP_CAPTURE: Capture keys from the game's login traffic and print them as keys.json groups. Requires administrator rights.
HELP_KEY: Decryption key for a single USM file, as the decimal videoKey or as audioKey:aesKey for 7.1+ files.
HELP_DEFAULT_AUDIO: Audio language code to flag as default.
HELP_DEFAULT_SUB: Subtitle language code to flag as default.
HELP_FLAT: Write each .mkv into the output folder instead of a folder per file.
HELP_VERSION: Display Charlotte's current version and exit.
MODE_WITH_OTHER_MODES: {flag} cannot be combined with input files or other modes.
KEY_WITH_MANY_FILES: --key is only valid with a single input file.
NOT_FILE_OR_DIRECTORY: Not a valid file or folder: {path}
KEYS_UPDATE_PROMPT: The key for {stem} is missing locally but available in the latest keys.json. Update keys.json now?
KEY_NOT_VIDEO_KEY: {stem} uses the old encryption, so --key must be a decimal videoKey.
KEY_NOT_STREAM_KEYS: {stem} uses the 7.1 encryption, so --key must be audioKey:aesKey.
CRACK_NO_VIDEO: no IVF video stream in this file
CRACK_ONE_PAYLOAD: unconfirmed because the video has only one distinct frame
CRACK_HALVES_DISAGREE: unconfirmed because the two halves of the {size}-byte sample disagree

SUBTITLE_ARCHIVE_INVALID: the subtitle archive is not a valid zip

FFMPEG_MISSING: FFmpeg not found. Place ffmpeg.exe in the root folder and try again.

UPDATE_NO_DIGEST: The latest release has no checksum to verify the download against.
UPDATE_WRITE_FAILED: Failed to write the update to disk: {error}
UPDATE_DIGEST_MISMATCH: The download does not match the release checksum (expected {expected}, got {actual}).
